paragraphs.text: Meg and Károly are talking about staying in contact. Károly explains that they should exchange a few practical details.
Meg asks Károly the same question. They laugh because Károly is not sure he wants to talk about his age.
Then they exchange contact details. Károly asks for Meg's address and phone number.

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: Budapesten lakom. A címem Kossuth utca 10.

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: A telefonszámom: nulla hat, három nulla, egy kettő három, négy öt hat, hét nyolc kilenc.
Meg checks the number and repeats it slowly. She can now give practical information without Károly translating every question.
They also mention Meg's birthday. It is a small piece of information, but the conversation feels increasingly natural.
